I've mapped the architecture. Here's my plan.

## How the podcast/episode system works today

The site is **Quartz v4**. Episodes are just markdown files in [`content/episodes/`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/tree/main/content/episodes) with frontmatter (`title`, `episodeId`, `date`, `coverImage`, `youtubeUrl`, `guestOffset`, `tags`). Three pieces give them their distinctive look:

1. **Episode page header & video embed** — [`quartz/components/pages/Content.tsx`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/pages/Content.tsx) hides the normal page title (CSS keyed on `body[data-slug^="episodes/"]`), renders a custom inline header (`EP00 · Title · date`), and injects a YouTube embed at the top of the article.
2. **Landing-page carousel** — [`quartz/components/EpisodeCarousel.tsx`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/EpisodeCarousel.tsx), wired in [`quartz.layout.ts`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz.layout.ts) to show only on the index page, filtered by the `episodes/` slug prefix. It's already generic (takes `title`/`filter`/`linkToMore`).
3. **Sidebar list** — `RecentNotes`, same filter.

Covers live in [`quartz/static/covers/`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/tree/main/quartz/static/covers) and are referenced as `/static/covers/EP00-cover.png`.

## Proposed approach

Yes — we can reuse the episode design almost wholesale. The plan:

1. **New content folder** `content/livestreams/` with an `index.md` ("All Livestreams") and the first entry (e.g. `ls01.md`), mirroring episode frontmatter but with a `streamId: "LIVE 01"` field instead of `episodeId`.
2. **Generalize `Content.tsx`** so the inline-header + top-of-article embed treatment also applies to `livestreams/` (add the prefix to the page check, read `episodeId ?? streamId`, and extend the CSS selector to `body[data-slug^="episodes/"], body[data-slug^="livestreams/"]`). No visual change to episodes.
3. **Reuse `EpisodeCarousel`** for a second "Livestreams" carousel on the index (new `livestreamsCarousel` in `quartz.layout.ts`, filtered to `livestreams/`), plus a `livestreamsSection` sidebar list. I'll add a small optional `itemNoun` option so the "See N more…" label can say "livestream" instead of "episode".
4. **Cover image** — save the attached image to `quartz/static/covers/LS01-cover.png` and reference it from the entry.

This keeps livestreams and episodes as parallel, independently-listed sections (matching "add a new section for live streams") while sharing the page chrome.

## Corrected first-entry content (draft)

> **Title:** Human-Centered LLMs — with Caleb Ziems, Dora Zhao & Diyi Yang
> **Video:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2d49pMXiJOA
>
> We hosted [Caleb Ziems](https://x.com/cjziems), [Dora Zhao](https://x.com/dorazhao9), and [Diyi Yang](https://x.com/Diyi_Yang) for a live discussion of their new paper, *Reflections and New Directions for Human-Centered Large Language Models*. Growing out of Stanford's CS329X Human-Centered LLM class, the paper distills 60+ pages of insights — across design, data sourcing, training, evaluation, and deployment — into a roadmap for building LLMs that humans can meaningfully live and work with. (More details to come.)

I'll drop the hallucinated paragraph entirely and link the paper + Diyi Yang's [announcement thread](https://x.com/Diyi_Yang/status/2057127600024432838).

## Questions before I build

1. **Section label** — call it "Livestreams" (and `streamId` like `LIVE 01`)? Or do you prefer "Live Streams" / a different ID scheme?
2. **Paper link** — do you have a direct arXiv/PDF URL? I'll otherwise link only the announcement thread for now.
3. The attached image — I'll use it as-is for the cover (1792×1080 crops fine to 16:9). Good?

This is the `/answer` flow, so I've stopped at the plan. **Approve and I'll implement it** (steps 1–4 above) in a PR.
